title: Item:Shattered Sigil
wikitext:
[[File:Shattered Sigil.png]]

An end-reward item from [[Slavers of the Shrieking Mines]] in [[The Restless Isles ]] chain. It is one-half of the items needed to create a [[Sigil of Dal Quor]], which is required to enter [[The Twilight Forge]]/[[The Titan Awakes]] raids.

Note that you can run that quest, and so collect this piece, at level 7, but you must be Level 8 (or higher) [[Quest minimum level|to qualify]] for the Level 11 raid, and so be recognized to assemble the two pieces.
